title: Web Email Alerts Window

children:
You can use this window to define email alerts in Trading Partner Management. 
 When the conditions of an alert is met, the system will send an email 
 message to the address(es) indicated on this window. You can access this 
 window from the Trading Partner Management Main Menu.

content_text:
Web Email Alerts Window
        You can use this window to define email alerts in Trading Partner Management. 
 When the conditions of an alert is met, the system will send an email 
 message to the address(es) indicated on this window. You can access this 
 window from the Trading Partner Management Main Menu.
         
         
        Field Descriptions...
            
                 
                Carrier
                
                Company
                
                Customer
                
                Email Address
                
                Email Alert Type
                
                Email Template
                
                Minimum Number of Lines
                
                Minimum Value
                
                Minimum Weight
                
                Ship To
                
                Status
